verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a self-hostable search engine, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out flag or setting. Self-hosting and open-source availability are adjacent deployment facts, not a documented telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
